messages:
harper: Quick heads-up: launching a docs + SDK enforcement rollout tomorrow. Two parts: (1) require x-redwood-key header in SDK defaults, (2) enable docs linter rule that flags old examples referencing `generate()` and `model` param.
jules: Will the header change break server-side apps that proxy requests?
harper: We will accept Authorization: Bearer for 60 days as a fallback, but new SDKs will prefer x-redwood-key. Well also add server-proxy guidance in the migration doc.
samir: Linter rule details? I want to avoid noisy CI alerts.
harper: Linter will target docs and quickstarts only, auto-fix available for `model` -> `model_id` and `generate()` -> `create_completion()` in JS/Py snippets. Teams can opt-out per-folder with a .docs-lint-ignore file during the 30-day grace.
maria: Do we have a codemod for repos that vendor examples?
harper: Yes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-tools/tree/main/codemods/sdk-headers-and-params - supports batch rewrite and a dry-run mode.
jules: Any telemetry or privacy changes to call out?
harper: No new telemetry. We will add a short privacy note in the migration page explaining the header name change and how it does not change token handling.
docs-bot: Migration guide published: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrations/auth-header-and-docs-lint - includes codemod, CI opt-out, and deprecation schedule.
samir: SRE: please watch for an uptick in 401/410 errors during first week after rollout. Also track docs linter failures hitting CI for teams that haven't opted out.
maria: I'll prepare a canned support response and a console banner draft for review.
harper: Rollout timeline: announce today, docs + codemod live now, linter enabled in soft-mode (warnings) for 14 days, hard enforcement (fail CI) in 42 days, legacy header removed in 60 days.
jules: Sounds good. I'll add a note in the release notes and send a brief email to top-20 SDK users.
docs-bot: Changelog entry created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511 - includes quickstart patches and linter config.
__notes: Simulated Slack thread for an internal docs/SDK enforcement rollout (auth header change + docs linter). Messages are short and formatted per agents.md; no title field included.
